profile.headline: Wireless Modem Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the semiconductors industry. Strong engineering professional skilled in Embedded Software, Wireless Modem Dataplane, Debugging, Firmware, and Wireless Technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.insights: Skills: RISC-V · ARM · Microcontrollers · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design dataplane architecture for NR/LTE modem system and define SW/HW partitioning and interface and estimate system requirement for L2 subsystem. 
Design custom instructions to accelerate RoHC stack.
Design VLIW based co-processor for ASN.1 encoder.

positions.description: Develop imaging pipelining and computer vision software on custom processor

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Integrate CDMA 1x and EVDO modem with LTE and 3gpp modem system.
positions.insights: Skills: ARM · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) · Microprocessors · Mobile Communications

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Develop multimode system selection software to support CDMA and LTE system inter-working.
Develop SUPL client for LTE multi-mode device to support location service.
Port open source SSL/TLS libraries to mobile baseband platform. 
Develop POSIX-compatible network APIs on top of proprietary TCP/IP stack to support SSL/TLS libraries.
positions.insights: Skills: Service Provider Interface (SPI) · ARM · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) · Software Architecture · Microprocessors · System Software · Mobile Communications

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop MAC sublayer software for WCDMA/HSPA/HSPA+ modem system
Explore modem architecture and evaluate system requirement on ESL platform, including accelerator modeling (systemC), SW/HW co-design, system performance analysis and optimization.
positions.insights: Skills: ARM · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) · Microprocessors · Mobile Communications

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop MAC and RLC sublayer protocol SW for WCDMA modem system. Integrate with PHY subsystem.
Bring up WCDMA modem evaluation platform (FPGA and EVB). Work on boot-loader, USB and UART drivers.
Develop MAC sublayer for CDMA EVDO modem system and optimize dataplane performance.
Develop RoHC (Robust Header Compression, RFC 3095) protocol stack for VoIP telephony application
positions.insights: Skills: Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter (UART) · ARM · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) · Microprocessors · System Software · Mobile Communications

patents.title: Apparatus and System for Multi-Mode Wireless Communication
patents.description: A multi-mode controller (MMC) manages communications on a wireless device to provide interoperability between multiple radio access technologies (RATs) or radio access protocols.
